entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Aliaksandr Makaranka is a Belarusian weightlifter. He competed for Belarus at the 2012 Summer Olympics, in the men's 94 kg division, finishing in fourth place with a snatch of 175 kg and a clean and jerk of 209 kg.
